svg.title: content program
svg.desc: A broad angular leaf, folded along its midrib and two creases, cut from a purple-600 tile. Drawn on the drawn-mark box and rules (docs/favicons/README.md): solid fills, no strokes, and every gap at least 2.5 units, which is about 1.4 CSS pixels at 16. Chosen 2026-11-07, the owner's faceted leaf made broader; the ideas it was chosen from are in docs/prototypes/program-mark-ideas.html.
